title: Commercial & Residential Building
description: A bold mixed-use development for Mr. Akshay Gavli — combining ground-floor retail with upper-level residences. Clean volumes, vertical louvers, integrated planters, and a marble-accented top floor define this Sangli landmark.

chapters.title: Design Vision
chapters.text: A four-story mixed-use building combining commercial retail at ground level with residential floors above — designed for maximum street presence and natural ventilation in Sangli.

chapters.title: Facade Composition
chapters.text: Vertical beige louvers rhythm the middle floors while a marble-veined top floor frame creates a distinctive crown — every element calibrated for shade, privacy, and visual impact.

chapters.title: Built Reality
chapters.text: From 3D visualization to on-site execution — the Kanchan residence nearby demonstrates how YCA translates rendered vision into lived architectural experience.

chapters.title: Material Craft
chapters.text: Stone cladding, geometric screens, and warm wood accents — material junctions executed with the precision that defines every YCA project.

chapters.title: On Site
chapters.text: Active construction across Sangli — our team on ground ensuring every floor, every opening, every finish matches the design intent.

title: Residence for Mr. Sudhakar Ruknar
description: A bold expression of modern living — clean volumes, warm wooden accents, and layered roof overhangs with integrated lighting define this contemporary Pandharpur residence.

title: Residence for Mr. Khatake
description: Organic curves meet geometric precision — arched windows, a sculptural funnel column, and warm stone cladding create a residence that feels both grounded and aspirational.

title: Kanchan Residence
description: Your facade is not just what people see — it is what they feel before stepping inside. A completed residence featuring geometric screens, layered volumes, and warm natural light.

title: Contemporary Living Room
description: Marble-feature TV wall with fluted panels, warm wood finishes, and open-plan living — where every piece tells a story and every space invites you to stay.

title: Luxury Jewellery Showroom
description: At Yogesh Chavan Associates, we design jewellery spaces where luxury meets functionality — circular display niches, gold accents, and ambient chandelier lighting.

title: Multi-Storey Commercial Tower
description: A tall commercial tower rising in urban Sangli — raw concrete form giving way to a landmark mixed-use destination.

title: Farmhouse Retreat for CA Ram Patil
description: A peaceful escape taking shape — terracotta roof tiles, open verandahs, and a rural setting reimagined as a weekend farmhouse retreat.
